description: Load a Docfarm skill, written instructions for a task that you then follow. docfarm/onboarding is the short tour for someone who has just connected Docfarm. Pass `id` (one id, or an array) for the full skill, `query` to search by keyword, or nothing to list every skill by name and description. When the person asks to use a Docfarm skill by name, call this with that id first.

id.description: One skill id such as "docfarm/onboarding", or several. Returns the full skill.

query.description: What the task is about, in plain words. Ignored when id is set.

name: get_skills
title: Loading skills...
